The '''Lightspring''' was a natural site of incredible beauty and serenity that was located deep within the most desolate reaches of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], within the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. Neither travelers nor hunters dared to enter this area which consisted of a huge cavern that contained massive pools of water, lit from below by a strange glow. This cast rippling shadows and reflections on the walls of the cavern. The area of the Lightspring was considered a holy site by the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] natives which was never to be disturbed or contaminated.<ref name="TORC" />

By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the sanctity of the site had been desecrated by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Diago Hixan]] who claimed it as the seat of his [[Diago Hixan's gang|criminal empire]]. Under his control, he filled the Lightspring cavern with numerous trinkets and baubles from his collection that turned this once pristine landmark into his own personal junkyard.<ref name="TORC" />

The [[search for Nok Drayen's treasure]] led a [[Voidhound|smuggler captain]] to Hixan's retreat in search for an artifact, with the ensuing confrontation leading to the crime lord's death.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Voidhound|Smuggler]]|The Lightspring|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>
